Team —

Quick context: Sergio has accepted a transfer to the Observability squad at Acme Platform (their infra partner project). His last day on Platform Runtime would be 2027-02-28, and the proposed start on Observability is 2027-03-01. Because this is a cross-team transfer and we want minimal disruption to the Runtime roadmap, I'm proposing a 6-week shadow and handover where Vivek will act as interim manager for Sergio during the overlap, with Marissa as backup for the first two weeks while I wrap up commitments.

Why now: Sergio requested the move during his career conversation and it's aligned with product needs at Acme. His most recent performance calibration (Nov 2026) is MEETS EXPECTATIONS; there are no active PIPs.

What I need from you:
- Marissa / Mina / HR: approval to start formal transfer (Workday ticket + signed transfer packet).
- Mina: confirmation there's no comp/benefits caveat for this lateral move.
- Vivek / Marissa: confirm interim manager coverage and the attached shadow schedule.

Attached: transfer_packet_draft.pdf (draft transfer form), shadow_schedule_v1.xlsx (day-by-day overlap plan), marissa_schedule_notes.docx (Marissa's suggested meeting hours).

Timeline suggestion:
- 2027-02-22: shadowing begins (technical pairing + weekly 1:1s)
- 2027-03-01: Sergio onboarded to Observability; Vivek remains point-of-contact for any Platform escalations through 2027-03-07.

If you have objections or conflicts with the dates, reply with alternatives today/tomorrow so we can route to People Ops. Sergio: please confirm this timeline works for you.

Thanks,
Priyom
